name: Al'tushki shizejuschie v bimbokor lesu
source:
Two girls who woke up in a winter forest are trying to get out of it. One of them is blind and the other is mute. They move deeper into the forest and notice more and more strange things. They can die, they can make friends, they can die
But under no circumstances can they leave the forest
Will they be able to realise what's going on before...

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/topic-223504963_53020583]VK[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩在冬季森林中醒来，正试图逃离森林。其中一个是盲人，另一个是哑巴。他们向森林深处走去，注意到越来越多奇怪的事情。他们可以死，他们可以交朋友，他们可以死
但无论如何他们都不能离开森林
他们能否意识到之前发生了什么……
